title: M2: apricity play --link: a native Link peer beside the DAW
description:
## Purpose
`apricity play --link` joins the Link session on the local network and plays the score in time with the DAW: bar 1 on the session's next bar line, the session's tempo, and start and stop from the session. Apricity **follows**: it never changes the session's tempo and never starts or stops other peers. `apricity link` shows the session.

## Scope
- New native-only crate `crates/apricity-link` (binding chosen in M0): join and leave, capture session state in the audio callback without allocating, peers, tempo, playing, a scripted session for tests.
- `crates/apricity-cli/src/play.rs`: feed the M1 clock line from the session at each buffer's playback time, compensating output latency.
- Flags on `play`: `--link`, `--quantum N` (default: the score's time signature), `--no-start-stop`, `--latency MS`. New subcommand `apricity link`.
- Proposing a tempo only when alone: the session starts at the score's tempo when there are no peers; later edits to `tempo` are reported as ignored.

## Out of scope
The browser (M3); sending audio into the DAW (loopback routing is the user's); song position (Link doesn't share it); the Swift app (it will reuse `apricity-link` later).

## Words
"Link", "Link session", "peer", "quantum", "start/stop sync". Not "sync" alone (that is `apricity sync`, the library) and not "follow" alone (that is `transpose follow`).

## Definition of Done
1. `features/link/play.feature` green via `crates/apricity-cli/tests/link_play.rs` on the scripted session; 100% coverage.
2. Rust only; no Python parity (the peer lives in Rust; `server.py` is being retired, apricitus-8cecf2).
3. No schema change.
4. CLI: flags, `--help` text, errors with the flag or the score's line and column; exit status 2 for usage errors.
5. Fixtures: reuse M1's click fixture.
6. `design/link.md` "Native peer" section; `design/vocabulary.md` gains the Link words.
7. Docs: `docs/tools.md` (`play --link`, `apricity link`), `docs/glossary.md` (Link, Link session, peer, quantum, start/stop sync, phase), a `docs/concepts.md` section "Playing beside a DAW over Link", README layout table row for `apricity-link`.
8. Web: none here.
9. Verify: `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-link -p apricity-cli`; plus the manual DAW check task, logged.
10. Running log on every task.
11. `feat(<task id>)`; not breaking. New native dependency (Link SDK, C++ build) noted for CI.
12. Depends on M0 and M1. Blocks M3 and M4. Relates apricitus-874f56 (licensing) and apricitus-1f0e91 (CI).
